```
import os,glob,re
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
```

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    fill=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    R=[r for r in range(h) if all(v!=fill for v in grid[r]) and len({v for v in grid[r] if v!=fill})>1]
    C=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]!=fill for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]})>1]
    lc=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r if v!=fill).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(R)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(C)-1):
            vals=[grid[R[i+k]][C[j+l]] for k in (0,1) for l in (0,1)]
            s=set(vals)
            row.append(vals[0] if len(s)==1 and vals[0] not in (fill,lc) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lc=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    def special(v): return v not in (fill,lc)
    R=[r for r in range(h) if any(special(v) for v in grid[r])]
    C=[c for c in range(w) if any(special(grid[r][c]) for r in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(R)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(C)-1):
            vals=[grid[R[i+k]][C[j+l]] for k in (0,1) for l in (0,1)]
            row.append(vals[0] if len(set(vals))==1 else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
